d0b80adf1a6f5d86918e02886582c035.value: This is an explicitly synthetic application verification case, not a real-world empirical study. Two independently randomized binary factors, each with levels 0 and 1. Use unadjusted arithmetic means of the four cells. Primary a_marginal is the effect of A, averaging its two within-B contrasts with equal weights. Secondary b_marginal analogously averages the within-A contrasts. interaction is (mu11-mu01)-(mu10-mu00). joint is mu11-mu00. Include every row. This fixture prespecifies point estimates only. Extend the point protocol only by this prespecified uncertainty calculation. For each contrast, use its linear coefficients on the four disjoint cell means. If a cell has sample variance s_j^2, count n_j and contrast coefficient c_j, variance is V=sum(c_j^2*s_j^2/n_j), with sample variances using ddof=1. Use Welch-Satterthwaite df=V^2/sum((c_j^2*s_j^2/n_j)^2/(n_j-1)). Return estimate +/- t.ppf(1-0.05/(2*4),df)*sqrt(V). This gives four two-sided 98.75% intervals using Bonferroni for a 95% family level. Use result_kind=estimate for all four effects. These are conditional numerical inference calculations for the synthetic design, not demonstrated confidence coverage. Use these exact effect identities: a_marginal, b_marginal, interaction, joint. Exactly a_marginal is primary; the other listed effects are prespecified secondary effects. Preserve one treatment factor per intervention variable; arms are not additional factors. Do not search for a favorable design, alter the point functional, omit requested effects, or use outcome values before the allowed phase. Include every source row except the exact subsets explicitly defining the fixed contrasts. Stop on missing/nonfinite required values or unexpected codes. No imputation, outcome-based exclusions, alternate bandwidths or unrequested analyses. Record necessary causal assumptions separately from supplied fixture facts.
